$schema: Discovery seed queries: (query, location) pairs in YOUR field. `/jobe onboard` GENERATES this from your target role titles x target locations, so after setup it reflects your actual search. It ships EMPTY on purpose -- Jobe assumes nothing about your field or industry. Run `/jobe onboard`, or add rows like { "query": "<your role title>", "location": "Remote" }. `location` is a metro or 'Remote'. `archetype` is optional and only used to emphasize evidence for ML/AI portfolios; omit it otherwise.
